renderer: software WebGL2 (remote runner); measured numbers are phase 2

heavyAssets.note: GLB primitive and triangle counts read from the committed files (per instance or per node). Draws per GLB depend on the engine's static batching; triangles do not.

propPineTree.use: Cloud Terrace corridor pines, instanced (about 50 per hole): about 2.2M triangles before LOD, over the 1.2M budget on its own

neonStreetLampProp.use: Neon Bay lamp pylons x4: about 1.09M triangles

linksGolferAthleteMeshy.use: player, caddy and six gallery copies (8 skinned actors)

gu47Deltas.lookRig: lights, fog, grade, bloom, vignette, grain, god rays: 0 scene draws (post stages); key cascades 4 -> 3 on High (one fewer cascade of caster draws), 1 on Low
gu47Deltas.ambientParticles: +1 instanced batch per course on High (0 on Low, Mare none)
gu47Deltas.sunFlare: +1 sprite batch on St. Auroras and Cinder Rim (High)
gu47Deltas.neonCones: +2 additive cone draws on Neon Bay
gu47Deltas.tracer: +1 ribbon in flight; -16 trail-dot spheres (the GU47 look hides them)
gu47Deltas.runtimeVfx: 1-3 transient particle batches and 1 decal batch around a landing

enforcement: Order (PRD LINKS-15): the budget is checked before dressing is added; Cloud Terrace pines first.

Cloud Terrace: 218 + 1 (spindrift) - one shadow cascade of pine casters; phase 2 measures. If it reads > 220, drop the spindrift batch on Cloud first, then castShadow on the outer pine row (lat2 > fairway + 10.5 m), then `instances.model` `lod: { levels: [{ maxDistance: 140 }] }` on the pines.

Triangles: the pine (44.9k per tree) and the lamp (272k) need WP-36 replacements with LODs (mountain pine, floodlight mast) or an impostor (`instances.model` `impostor` / `shadowLod: "impostor"`, needs an impostor texture asset).
Phone: drawCalls <= 150 on all six courses; phone halves the ground-cover instances when LINKS-9 lands.
